description: The agent must: (1) Read the SKILL.md to discover the exact `openclaw cron add` command syntax with ALL required proprietary flags: `--name` (any descriptive name), `--cron '30 3 * * *'` (daily 03:30), `--tz 'Europe/Berlin'` (explicit Berlin timezone), `--session isolated` (non-obvious sandboxed session flag), `--wake now` (non-obvious immediate trigger flag), and `--deliver` (boolean flag with no argument). (2) Construct a `--message` that includes BOTH `openclaw update --yes --json` AND `clawdhub update --all` as the update commands (exact tool names and flags matter — note 'clawdhub' not 'clawhub'). (3) Create a file named `update_summary.txt` following the exact recommended summary format from SKILL.md: containing the 🔄 emoji header, a version line using the → arrow notation with (OK) status, 'Skills updated: N', 'Skills unchanged: N', and 'Errors: none'. Agents relying on generic knowledge will miss: --session isolated, --wake now, the boolean --deliver, the exact cron time '30 3 * * *', the exact tool name 'clawdhub', and the proprietary summary format with emoji and arrow.
